signModel.description: Explicit mixed per-metric signed-Greek OI convention: GEX applies +gamma for calls and -gamma for puts; DEX/Vanna/Charm apply the signed model Greek with no right multiplier. Not customer-long across all metrics; not observed dealer inventory.

forwardVolMatrixLeg.description: REF06 expiry clock: equity date-only expiries map to 20:00:00.000Z on the supplied date solely as a model-time approximation (ref06-equity-date-20utc-v1; not observed/settlement/cutoff; no venue/DST/holiday adjustment); crypto date labels derive from provider expiryMs (ref06-crypto-provider-instant-v1). DTE is fractional elapsed time from envelope asOf to the applicable instant divided by 86,400,000 ms; T=DTE/365, unrounded.

expiry.description: UTC date label only. Equity: upstream expiry date label, not an observed instant (DTE uses the 20:00 UTC model instant ref06-equity-date-20utc-v1). Crypto: UTC date label derived from provider expiryMs.

dte.description: Fractional elapsed calendar days from envelope asOf to the applicable expiry instant (equity: model 20:00 UTC instant; crypto: provider expiryMs), divided by 86,400,000 ms. Unrounded; null when expired/nonfinite/missing.

atmIv.description: Nearest-to-spot ATM IV leg input. Provenance follows ivBasis; provider IV is not claimed to be solved midpoint IV.

forwardVolMatrixCell.description: Forward-vol cell conditional on the applicable expiry instants (equity: model 20:00 UTC instants; crypto: provider expiryMs). Negative forward variance (any) is null; exact zero with distinct increasing DTE may be 0.

startExpiry.description: Start-leg UTC date label (equity: not an observed instant; crypto: derived from provider expiryMs).

endExpiry.description: End-leg UTC date label (equity: not an observed instant; crypto: derived from provider expiryMs).

startDte.description: Start-leg DTE: fractional elapsed time from envelope asOf to the applicable start instant divided by 86,400,000 ms, unrounded.

endDte.description: End-leg DTE: fractional elapsed time from envelope asOf to the applicable end instant divided by 86,400,000 ms, unrounded.

value.description: Forward volatility from total variance. Equity: conditional on model 20:00 UTC instants (ref06-equity-date-20utc-v1). Crypto: uses provider expiryMs (ref06-crypto-provider-instant-v1). Null when expired/invalid/missing, negative variance, or out of range; never NaN/Infinity.

ivBasis.description: ATM IV basis as currently labelled (equity derived-solved-mid, crypto observed-mark). Provider IV is not claimed to be solved midpoint IV until independently evidenced.

policyScenarioFixingPoint.description: One fixing-line point. observedValue is caller-supplied observed SOFR (percent-100); scenarioValue after the last observed fixing is scenario, never observed. Missing values are null (Unavailable), never zero-filled.

observedValue.description: Observed SOFR fixing in percent-100; null when no fixing was supplied for this date.

scenarioValue.description: Scenario fixing in percent-100: observed where supplied, otherwise last-observed plus cumulative steps (scenario, never observed).

cumulativeStepBps.description: Cumulative meeting steps effective on or before this date, in basis points.

policyScenarioWindowRow.description: One predicted-vs-current contract row over an explicit caller-supplied window. predictedRate is scenario (Actual/360 publication-interval compounding); currentRate is observed only with explicit source/date; missing stays null (Unavailable). Rates are percent-100; differenceBps is basis points.

policyScenarioData.description: REF-08/N3c policy-scenario result: observed fixing inputs kept separate from derived scenario outputs. stepBps inputs are explicit scenario decisions, never inferred midpoints; target bounds are display metadata; spread stays null when omitted.

policySpreadBps.description: Optional explicit SOFR/policy spread override in basis points; null when omitted.
